seo.title: Facebook Messenger AI chatbot | Steps AI
seo.description: Answer customers who message your Facebook page with an AI agent that knows your business and hands over to your team.

hero.title: Answer every message to your Facebook page.
hero.body: Customers who message your Facebook page get an answer from your own information, any time of day. Your team sees every conversation in the shared inbox.
hero.reassurance: One Meta connection. The same agent as your other channels. Your team can step in.

jobs.title: What your agent does on Messenger.
jobs.intro: The same answers and actions as on your website and WhatsApp.

items.title: Answer common questions
items.body: Opening hours, prices, delivery and policies from your own information.

items.title: Help customers buy or book
items.body: Recommend products, share a checkout link or book an appointment.

items.title: Capture leads
items.body: Collect the details your team needs and save them to your CRM.

items.title: Hand over to your team
items.body: Move the conversation to your shared inbox when a person is needed.

triggers.title: Why add Messenger.
triggers.intro: Many customers still message the Facebook page first.

items.title: Cover your Facebook page
items.body: Answer people who find you on Facebook without waiting for your team.

items.title: Keep one set of answers
items.body: Edit your information once and every channel uses it.

items.title: See it all in one inbox
items.body: Messenger conversations sit next to WhatsApp, Instagram and website chats.

setup.title: Connect Messenger once.
setup.intro: The same Meta connection covers WhatsApp and Instagram.

items.title: Connect through Meta
items.body: Sign in to Meta and choose your Facebook page.

items.title: Choose the agent
items.body: Pick which agent answers your page messages.

items.title: Test it, then go live
items.body: Send a test message and check the answer before customers do.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: You need admin access to the Facebook page to connect it.
Messenger does not share state-level location for analytics.

items.q: Do I need a separate setup for Instagram and WhatsApp?
items.a: No. One Meta connection covers all three.

items.q: Can I pause the agent on Messenger?
items.a: Yes. A connected channel can be paused and resumed.

items.label: Instagram chatbot
items.body: Reply to DMs and turn comments into conversations.

cta.title: See the Messenger chatbot with your own business in mind.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through it using your own information and channels.
